summary: Created Redux state structure for SMS message scheduling and delivery management. Added smsSlice with messages array, loading, and error state. Defined message data model with id, recipientPhone, messageContent, scheduledTime, status, createdAt, updatedAt, and retryCount fields. Implemented addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, and setError reducers. Created selector functions: selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus. Added JSDoc type definitions in sms.types.js with MessageStatus enum (SCHEDULED, SENT, FAILED) and Message/SmsState type definitions. Configured Redux store with configureStore and wrapped App with Provider in main.jsx. Added @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux dependencies to package.json.
